module_summary: Serial accumulator summing four 8-bit inputs: a 2-bit counter tracks accepted samples, an accumulator register adds data_in, and valid_out pulses when the fourth sample arrives.

anchors.name: data_in
anchors.why: 8-bit sample loaded or added into accumulator.

anchors.name: valid_in
anchors.why: Input valid enabling accumulation via ready_add.

anchors.name: count
anchors.why: Counts accepted samples 0..3; restarts accumulation at zero.

anchors.name: data_out
anchors.why: 10-bit accumulator register outputting the four-sample sum.

anchors.name: valid_out
anchors.why: One-cycle pulse when fourth sample accumulated.

anchors.name: add_cnt
anchors.why: Accumulate/count enable for counter and data registers.

anchors.name: end_cnt
anchors.why: Fourth-sample flag resetting count and setting valid_out.

anchors.name: ready_add
anchors.why: Accept condition from valid_in or idle output.

anchors.name: data_out_reg
anchors.why: Duplicate unused accumulator register mirroring data_out.

groups.name: Sample counter
groups.description: Counts four accepted samples, generates enables and end flag.

groups.name: Accumulator
groups.description: Loads first sample then adds subsequent samples.

groups.name: Output valid
groups.description: Pulses valid_out when four samples accumulated.
